# KPN Roofing Shed

> Roofing Shed Construction Company in India

KPN Roofing Shed is a roofing shed construction company based in Tamil Nadu, India. The company designs and builds roofing shed solutions for agriculture, animal husbandry, industrial, home, and sports applications across India.

KPN Roofing Shed has 13+ years of experience and has completed 1000+ projects.

## Main Services

- Agriculture & Animal Husbandry Sheds
- Industrial Sheds
- Home Roofing Sheds
- Sports Turf Sheds

## Agriculture & Animal Husbandry Sheds

KPN provides roofing shed solutions for livestock and poultry requirements.

- Goat Farm Shed
- Cow / Dairy Farm Shed
- Poultry Farm Shed

KPN also manufactures slatted floor mats in-house at its Coimbatore facility for animal shed applications. The mats are manufactured using virgin raw material and are designed to support drainage, hygiene, and ventilation.

## Industrial Sheds

KPN provides industrial roofing shed solutions for manufacturing, garment, storage, and commercial requirements.

- Factory Shed
- Garment Factory Shed
- Warehouse & Godown Shed

## Home Roofing Sheds

KPN provides roofing solutions for residential properties and outdoor spaces.

- Car Parking Shed
- Terrace Roofing Shed

## Sports Turf Sheds

KPN provides roofing shed solutions for sports facilities and covered playing areas.

- Badminton Court Shed
- Cricket Turf Shed

## Corporate Social Responsibility

KPN Roofing Shed supports students, athletes, sports activities, and traditional arts through its CSR initiatives.

## Company Information

- Company: KPN Roofing Shed
- Industry: Roofing Shed Construction
- Experience: 13+ years
- Projects Completed: 1000+
- Service Area: India
- Base: Tamil Nadu, India
- Steel Brand: Apollo
